title: CI push paths filter skips CLAUDE.md-only pushes for jobs that read CLAUDE.md (OPAG-432 AC3)
description: Routed by opum-agent OPAG-432 AC3 (fleet audit). ci.yml's push trigger (branches: [main]) carries paths-ignore '**/*.md', which ignores CLAUDE.md, while three jobs read it for the declared Quest version: Tracker integrity (tracker), lore check (docs gate) (docs-gate), and compile smoke (ubuntu) (build, via the README quickstart). So a push to main touching only CLAUDE.md gets no push-triggered run of them. Context worth keeping: the pull_request trigger is unfiltered, so the same change runs all three before it reaches dev; the gap is the post-promotion main push only. Fix: stop ignoring CLAUDE.md on push (GitHub evaluates paths-ignore patterns in order, and a '!' pattern re-includes a path; verify on a real run).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A push to main that changes only CLAUDE.md triggers the three jobs, proven by a real run (or by a workflow-syntax test plus the run on the next such promotion)
test/ci-workflow.test.ts pins that CLAUDE.md is not ignored by the push filter

plan: 2. Replace the push trigger paths-ignore entry **/*.md with */**/*.md (nested markdown only) plus an explicit list of root-level .md files, omitting CLAUDE.md and README.md; leave docs/**, backlog/** and .claude/** exactly as they are (docs/** is OPAG-444).

3. Pin in test/ci-workflow.test.ts, with a matcher implementing the documented GitHub filter-pattern cheat-sheet semantics, that CLAUDE.md and README.md are not ignored on push and every other ignored path is unchanged.
4. Mutation: restore **/*.md and confirm the new tests go red.
5. Gates: full bun test and bun run lore check from source, both exit 0.
6. Check AC2 on evidence; leave AC1 for the next CLAUDE.md-touching promotion.
implementationNotes: Pattern choice (GitHub workflow-syntax reference, Filter pattern cheat sheet, fetched 2026-09-26): push paths-ignore now reads */**/*.md plus root Markdown by name (CHANGELOG, CODE_OF_CONDUCT, CONTRIBUTING, DEVELOPMENT, ECK-ALIGNMENT, SECURITY, lore-spec), CLAUDE.md and README.md deliberately absent; docs/**, backlog/**, .claude/** unchanged (docs/** is OPAG-444). Why: the cheat sheet says * never matches / and documents docs/**/*.md matching docs/README.md, so */**/*.md matches Markdown at any depth under a directory and cannot match a root file. The ! re-include alternative was rejected: the docs define ordered negation for `paths` only, and if a !CLAUDE.md were unsupported under paths-ignore CLAUDE.md would silently stay ignored, the exact failure being removed; the chosen list fails the other way (an unlisted or mis-globbed file RUNS CI). Evidence: test/ci-workflow.test.ts adds a matcher that reproduces 17 cheat-sheet examples as a positive control, then asserts CLAUDE.md/README.md not ignored (and were ignored under the old list), every previously ignored sample path still ignored, and the pattern list pinned exactly. Mutation: restoring **/*.md turns exactly the 2 predicted tests red (CLAUDE/README test, pinned list), 18 green; listing CLAUDE.md by name reddens the same 2. Gates on this tree: bun test exit 0 (3478 pass, 1 skip, 0 fail, 109 files), bun run lore check exit 0 (82 files, 0 errors; lore 0.9.3 from source, quest 0.10.0), lint and typecheck exit 0. AC1 needs a real CLAUDE.md-only push to main and stays unchecked until the next such promotion proves it.

Findings outside this task scope, reported not changed: (1) skills/lore/SKILL.md is still ignored on push (*/**/*.md), yet test/plugin-skill.test.ts reads it and asserts it equals the generated bytes, and skills/ is what opum-marketplace federates by tag, so a skills-only push to main runs no tests. (2) test/repository-location.test.ts scans EVERY tracked file (git ls-files) for superseded identities and names CHANGELOG.md and ECK-ALIGNMENT.md explicitly, so by this task own rationale (jobs that read the file) every Markdown path is read by the test job; which Markdown the push trigger may skip is the same design question OPAG-444 holds for docs/**. (3) CLAUDE.md repository profile still says the push trigger carries paths-ignore for **/*.md; that prose is now stale, and CLAUDE.md is outside this task scope (and a governing file), so the owning session should update it.
Delivering PR: opum-ai/lore-cli#293 (branch lcli-602-ci-push-reads-claude-md, base dev). Not merged; task left In Progress for the parent session to complete.
finalSummary: ci.yml's push trigger (branches: [main]) no longer ignores CLAUDE.md or README.md. '**/*.md' became '*/**/*.md' (Markdown below the root; per GitHub's cheat sheet '*' never matches '/', and '**/' matches zero directories) plus the root .md files named explicitly, CLAUDE.md and README.md deliberately omitted; docs/**, backlog/** and .claude/** unchanged (docs/** is OPAG-444's question). A '!' re-include was rejected: GitHub documents ordered negation for 'paths' only, and if unsupported under paths-ignore CLAUDE.md would silently stay ignored; the explicit list fails toward running more. test/ci-workflow.test.ts gains a small GitHub-glob matcher (positive control against 17 cheat-sheet examples) and pins: CLAUDE.md/README.md not ignored now but ignored under the old list, 14 previously-ignored paths still ignored, the exact 11-entry list, and the unfiltered pull_request trigger. Mutation: restoring '**/*.md', or listing CLAUDE.md, turns exactly the 2 predicted tests red. The repository profile in CLAUDE.md, which described the old filter twice, is corrected in the same PR. Verified: full bun test 0 (3479 tests), bun run lore check 0 (lore 0.9.3 from source, quest 0.10.0). AC1 is left UNCHECKED on purpose: it needs a real CLAUDE.md-only push to main, which cannot happen before merge; the next such promotion proves it. Delivered in opum-ai/lore-cli#293. Out of scope, routed to opum-agent: skills/**/*.md (federated by opum-marketplace, read by test/plugin-skill.test.ts) and every other Markdown file (test/repository-location.test.ts scans all tracked files) are still skipped on a main push, the same question as OPAG-444.
